title: Dog
description: Schema for dog data collected from ShelterLuv. Frontend renders: Name, Age, Size, Gender, Status, Photos, Description, CaseManager, AdoptionCategory, MedicalCategory, BehaviorCategory. Supports role-based access to foster contact information and structured memo tabs.

Internal-ID.description: [API] ShelterLuv internal unique identifier - from ShelterLuv API field 'Internal-ID'

ID.description: [API] ShelterLuv public animal ID - from ShelterLuv API field 'ID'

Name.description: [API] Dog's name - from ShelterLuv API field 'Name'

Breed.description: [API] Dog's breed - from ShelterLuv API field 'Breed'

AgeYears.description: [DERIVED] Canonical age in years for sorting/filtering (e.g., 3.5 for 3 years 6 months) - computed from ShelterLuv age data

AgeDisplay.description: [DERIVED] Human-readable age representation (e.g., '3 years', 'Adult', 'Senior') - computed from ShelterLuv age data

Size.description: [API] Dog's size category - from ShelterLuv API field 'Size'. UNKNOWN indicates size could not be determined.

Gender.description: [API] Dog's gender - from ShelterLuv API field 'Gender'

Status.description: [API] Current status in shelter system - from ShelterLuv API field 'Status'. UNKNOWN indicates status could not be determined from ShelterLuv data.

Description.description: [API] Dog's description/bio - from ShelterLuv API field 'Description'

items.description: [API] URL to dog photo - from ShelterLuv API field 'Photos'

Photos.description: [API] Array of photo URLs - from ShelterLuv API field 'Photos'

CaseManager.description: [SCRAPED] Assigned case manager name - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

MemosRawHTML.description: [SCRAPED] Raw HTML content of all memos/notes - scraped from ShelterLuv memos page

PersonalityNotes.description: [DERIVED] Personality and behavior notes extracted from MemosRawHTML - categorized by ETL based on keywords (personality, behavior, temperament, etc.)

IntakeNotes.description: [DERIVED] Intake and background notes extracted from MemosRawHTML - categorized by ETL based on keywords (intake, background, history, etc.)

MedicalNotes.description: [DERIVED] Medical notes extracted from MemosRawHTML - categorized by ETL based on keywords (medical, health, vet, treatment, etc.)

MedicalHistory.description: [DERIVED] Comprehensive medical history extracted from ShelterLuv animal record summary page

vaccinations.description: Vaccination history with dates, status, lot numbers, expiration dates

treatments_due.description: Treatments and medications that are next due

resolved_diagnoses.description: Previously diagnosed conditions that have been resolved

procedures_surgeries.description: Surgical procedures and medical procedures performed

AdoptionCategory.description: [SCRAPED] Adoption category - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

MedicalCategory.description: [SCRAPED] Medical category - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

BehaviorCategory.description: [SCRAPED] Behavior category - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

VolunteerCategory.description: [SCRAPED] Volunteer category - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

FullAnimalProfile.description: [SCRAPED] Full animal profile text - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

Treatments.description: [DERIVED] Medical treatments history - structured from scraped data

IntakeDate.description: [API] Date the dog was taken into custody - from ShelterLuv API field 'IntakeDate'

Location.description: [API] Current location in shelter - from ShelterLuv API field 'Location'

Stage.description: [API] Current stage in adoption process - from ShelterLuv API field 'Stage'

Weight.description: [API] Dog's weight in pounds - from ShelterLuv API field 'Weight'

FosterName.description: [DERIVED] Name of current foster parent - derived from ShelterLuv events and people data. ROLE RESTRICTED: closers/staff only

FosterPhone.description: [DERIVED] Foster parent's phone number - derived from ShelterLuv people data. ROLE RESTRICTED: closers/staff only

FosterEmail.description: [DERIVED] Foster parent's email address - derived from ShelterLuv people data. ROLE RESTRICTED: closers/staff only

ScrapeError.description: [DERIVED] Error message if scraping dog details failed - shows in UI as warning

IsInCustody.description: [DERIVED] Dog is currently in Muttville's custody. True if dog is actively managed by Muttville (not adopted/returned). Computed from Status and ETL source data - all dogs from ShelterLuv 'In Custody' view are in custody.

IsAvailableForAdoption.description: [DERIVED] Dog is actively available for public adoption. True only when Status is 'AVAILABLE'. Used by frontend to filter adoptable dogs.

IsHospice.description: [DERIVED] Dog is in Muttville's hospice care program. Computed from MedicalCategory, Stage, event history, and hospice-related keywords in metadata.

IsEventDog.description: [DERIVED] Dog participates in public events/outreach. Computed from event history, AdoptionCategory, BehaviorCategory, and event-related keywords in description/personality notes.

Attributes.description: [SCRAPED] Attribute tags for this dog - scraped from ShelterLuv Attributes tab (e.g., 'Cat-friendly', 'Potty trained'). Used for filtering and display in UI.

BehavioralAttributes.description: [SCRAPED] Behavioral attribute tags for this dog - scraped from ShelterLuv behavioral attributes section (e.g., 'Cat-friendly', 'Energy Level - Moderate'). Used for filtering and display in UI.

PhysicalAttributes.description: [SCRAPED] Physical/medical attribute tags for this dog - scraped from ShelterLuv physical attributes section (e.g., 'Dental Disease', 'Heart Murmur'). Used for filtering and display in UI.

Species.description: [SCRAPED] Species of the animal - scraped from ShelterLuv overview section.

Color.description: [SCRAPED] Color of the dog - scraped from ShelterLuv overview section.

Pattern.description: [SCRAPED] Pattern/markings of the dog - scraped from ShelterLuv overview section.

DistinguishingMarks.description: [SCRAPED] Distinguishing marks/features - scraped from ShelterLuv overview section.

AdoptionPrice.description: [SCRAPED] Adoption price - scraped from ShelterLuv overview section.

MicrochipNumber.description: [SCRAPED] Microchip number - scraped from ShelterLuv microchip section.

MicrochipIssuer.description: [SCRAPED] Microchip issuer - scraped from ShelterLuv microchip section.

MicrochipImplantDate.description: [SCRAPED] Microchip implant date - scraped from ShelterLuv microchip section.

AlteredBeforeArrival.description: [SCRAPED] Whether the dog was altered before arrival - scraped from ShelterLuv sex/weight section.

AlteredInCare.description: [SCRAPED] Whether the dog was altered while in care - scraped from ShelterLuv sex/weight section.

AgeGroup.description: [SCRAPED] Age group category - scraped from ShelterLuv size/age section.

EstBirthdate.description: [SCRAPED] Estimated birthdate - scraped from ShelterLuv size/age section.

IntakeType.description: [SCRAPED] Intake type - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

IntakeSubtype.description: [SCRAPED] Intake subtype - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

OutcomeType.description: [SCRAPED] Outcome type - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

OutcomeSubtype.description: [SCRAPED] Outcome subtype - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

AsilomarIntake.description: [SCRAPED] Asilomar intake score - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

AsilomarOutcome.description: [SCRAPED] Asilomar outcome score - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

ConditionAtIntake.description: [SCRAPED] Condition at intake - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

JurisdictionIntake.description: [SCRAPED] Intake jurisdiction - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

JurisdictionOutcome.description: [SCRAPED] Outcome jurisdiction - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

RabiesTagNumber.description: [SCRAPED] Rabies tag number - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

PreviousShelterId.description: [SCRAPED] Previous shelter ID - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

PreviousShelterType.description: [SCRAPED] Previous shelter type - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.

PreviousShelterIssuer.description: [SCRAPED] Previous shelter issuer - scraped from ShelterLuv intake/outcome section.
